digest.component_or_area: LLM provider factory and session management
propositions: Provider construction is currently scattered across runner.py with inline provider-specific branches, making each new provider addition a surgical change to the hottest function

ProviderSession must centralize provider construction into a single factory pattern that leverages pydantic-ai's infer_model(provider_factory=...) hook, enabling additive provider registration without modifying runner.run()

Client lifecycle teardown requires ProviderSession to own httpx.AsyncClient instances via a _closeables list and context manager exit, since the provider_factory callable can only return a Provider, not the underlying client
The Anthropic builder moves existing construction logic verbatim into providers.py while preserving tenacity transport, max_retries=0 guard, loopback-proxy bypass, and per-request timeouts unchanged
After run() completes or raises, every httpx.AsyncClient that ProviderSession constructed must be confirmed closed on the real client object, preventing resource leaks
Unregistered provider names must raise LLMConfigError with registered provider names listed, replacing generic KeyError lookup failures
